'''Cribbler''' is a [[Water]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Clawzor]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Cribblers were originally ordinary crabs, but marine pollution made them into something more. With a massive left claw, they can shatter enemy shells with ease."

Cribbler is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A purple crab with a white underside and angry, red eyelids. Its irises are purple and its pupils are white. One of its claws is significantly larger than its body, similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiddler_crab fiddler crab]. The tips of its claws are also red.

Cribbler's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with yellow.

== Evolution Trial ==
Cribbler's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Clawzor]] you need to complete the following task:
* In [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]], upgrade Cribbler to Lvl 5 or above for a total of 1 time(s).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Cribber's not so tanky, so don't get hit by Zobos too much before evolving."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Steel is no match for Cribbler's claws, and peers often compete to see who can snap more rebars in a single clamp."

==Strategy==
[[File:Cribbler Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Cribbler's attack range]]
Best placed in the frontline, away from the far right lane to maximize attack range.
